أتكاتف (form VI)

# أَتَكَاتَفَ (ʔatakātafa) /ʔa.ta.kaː.ta.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَكَاتَفَ (takātafa)
# أَتَكَاتَفْ (ʔatakātaf) /ʔa.ta.kaː.taf/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَكَاتَفَ (takātafa)
